title: What does PandaDoc cost versus DocuSign and Jotform Sign in Year 1?
strategic_rationale: Year-1 e-signature cost across PandaDoc, DocuSign, and Jotform Sign.
verification_note: Checked 2026-11-13. PandaDoc pricing and https://support.pandadoc.com/en/articles/9715033-compare-subscription-plan-features: Free 5 documents a month, Starter $19/$35 per seat, Business $49/$65, Enterprise quote. Automation credits have no published pack price. API stops when credits run out. Other automation overage is the order-form unit price or up to $5 a document. HIPAA is not on Starter or Business. PandaDoc's own MSA was not loaded, so the page states only the BBB auto-renew fact: cancel at least 30 days before renewal, reminder 45 days ahead. One BBB case: 250 Forms credits then $2 a document. DocuSign pricing and https://www.docusign.com/blog/docusign-plans-and-pricing: Personal $10/$11/$15, Standard $25/$30/$45, Business Pro $40/$45/$65, up to 50 users, 100 envelopes per user per year on annual plans and 10 per user per month on monthly plans. The article states pay-as-you-go overage of $3.60 to $7.80 and does not assign a rate to each plan. nodshake https://www.nodshake.com/guides/docusign-cost-per-envelope lists Standard annual $3.60, Standard monthly $5.40, Business Pro annual $5.80, Business Pro monthly $7.80, labeled third-party. SMS from $0.36, ID verification from $2.40. HIPAA is Enhanced, a quote. Jotform pricing and Jotform Sign: Starter 10, Bronze 100 at $39/mo or $408/yr, Silver 250 at $49/mo or $468/yr, Gold 1,000 at $129/mo or $1,188/yr, Enterprise quote. Paid self-serve plans are single-user. HIPAA on Gold and Enterprise. Nonprofit and 24-hour discounts are not used. No PandaDoc affiliate link. Jotform uses the pricing URL in affiliate_links.json with the line Paid partnership with Jotform (#JotformPartner).

title: What does Apollo cost in Year 1 versus ZoomInfo and Sales Navigator?
strategic_rationale: Year-1 Apollo cost for a small or mid-size outbound team, counting seats, email and phone credits, credits that do not roll over, one plan for every seat, and add-on credits, versus ZoomInfo, Sales Navigator, or a split stack.
verification_note: Read live 2026-11-14 on https://www.apollo.io/pricing and https://www.apollo.io/pricing/about-credits. Annual per seat per month: Free $0 with 900 credits a year granted monthly, Basic $49 with 30,000 credits a year upfront, Professional $79 with 48,000 credits a year upfront, Organization $119 with a 3-seat minimum and 72,000 credits a year upfront. Monthly view: Free $0 with 75 credits, Basic $65 with 2,500 credits, Professional $99 with 4,000 credits. Organization shows $149 and Annual Only, so the year uses $119. Email is 1 credit. A phone number is 8 credits. Credits do not roll over. Advanced Dialer is $119 per team per month billed annually and is not in the Year-1 total. No per-minute dialer rate is on Apollo's credits page. Add-on credit price is not published. Custom is a quote. Sales Navigator compare-plans, FAQ updated 27 Sep 2026: Core $119.99 a month or $1,079.88 a year, Advanced $159.99 a month or $1,799.88 a year. LinkedIn calls those estimates. Advanced Plus is a quote. Up to five Advanced licenses online. 50 InMail a month. No email or phone reveal credits. ZoomInfo pricing and the 1 May 2025 terms: no public list price, each export is one credit, the agreement is not cancellable. The renewal notice stays on the ZoomInfo exit page (March 6 2024 terms, 60-day written notice; the May 1 2025 terms omit the window). Third-party inputs, editable: platform about $14,995 a year, about $1,500 a seat, 3-seat minimum, about 5,000 bulk export credits. ZoomInfo's AI information page says figures such as $14,995 are out of date. Vendr median $33,500 a year is not the default total. Sources: https://www.getcleed.com/blog/zoominfo-pricing and https://www.pin.com/blog/zoominfo-pricing/. Apollo is the affiliate through /go/apollo. ZoomInfo and LinkedIn are not.

title: What does Jotform cost in Year 1 for a team of 3 to 4?
strategic_rationale: Year-1 cost for a team of 3 to 4 that needs shared forms and data, comparing several single-user plans with Enterprise, including when a HIPAA BAA is required.
verification_note: Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/jotform/comments/1w0ud3g/why_cant_a_small_team_have_separate_individual/. https://www.jotform.com/pricing, read 2026-11-10: Bronze $408 a year, Silver $468 a year, Gold $1,188 a year, all single-user, and HIPAA only on Gold and Enterprise. https://www.jotform.com/enterprise/faq/: the base package includes up to 5 users, the price is a quote, the term is paid up front, there is no trial or refund, a HIPAA server costs extra, and shared logins are not allowed for PHI. Four Gold annual plans are 4 times $1,188, which is $4,752, and that is not an Enterprise price. Stay unknown: the Enterprise price, the HIPAA server add-on, whether several individual accounts in one organization are allowed in practice, and the 50% campaign discount, which must not be used as a baseline. Use the existing Jotform affiliate link with the disclosure line Paid partnership with Jotform (#JotformPartner).
